title: Pan-Seared Dutch Potatoes
description: A simple recipe to pan-sear Dutch potatoes with a crispy exterior and a fluffy interior.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Dutch potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Reduce heat to medium-low and continue cooking for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the potatoes are cooked through.
Remove the potatoes from the skillet and serve hot.
